svg.title: Loadout
svg.desc: Models and training: PyTorch, Transformers, seq2seq T5, distillation, MLX, ONNX Runtime. Agents and product: JavaScript, Electron, Node.js, Claude Agent SDK, MCP, Python. Infrastructure and evaluation: AWS, Cloudflare, Linux, Supabase and Postgres, GPU fleets, LLM-judge evaluations.
